tryIt: Open shukr on the watch during a prayer: the ring fills and is coloured like the phone's circle
Tap the ring: "ends 6:45 PM" ⇄ "54m left"
Complications (circular, corner, Smart Stack): fill forward in the same colour; dashed ring + NEXT before a prayer starts

entries.title: Feedback: "Still off" on a card that already has an unsent note no longer copies or overwrites it; each gets its own box
tryIt: Write a note on a card (don't send) → on its addressed note tap Still off: the box is empty; save it
The card's own box still has your first note

entries.title: Azkar sorting keeps a steady order for ties (built-ins in their usual order, yours A–Z); a search of just spaces doesn't count
tryIt: Azkar → Sort → Least recited: the never-used ones stay in the usual order

entries.title: Azkar sort, simpler: pick one field (Times recited, Pace, Last used, Name) and an ↑ / ↓ direction; built-ins always show, below yours
tryIt: Azkar → the sort button left of the search → Times recited: most first; open it again → Ascending: fewest first
The button shows ↑ or ↓ while a sort is on; Default puts it back

entries.title: NEXT uses your playground settings by default (a touch smaller, lighter and closer to the name)
tryIt: Mark the current prayer → the circle shows NEXT with the new look

entries.title: NEXT is back to its original look (your playground tweak is undone); saved playground values are cleared once
tryIt: Open the app → the circle's NEXT looks as it did before the tweak (no playground reset needed)

entries.title: Lock Screen round Prayers widget: a smaller prayer icon, so the name and time have more room
tryIt: Lock Screen → the round Prayers widget: the icon is smaller above the name (and time, before a prayer starts)

entries.title: Azkar sort: Name A to Z is the default (both sections alphabetical); no separate Default; direction rows are one short line (A to Z, Most first, Fastest first, Recent first…)
tryIt: Azkar → the sort button: pick a field, then the arrow row that reads how you want it
Name, A to Z shows the plain sort icon; anything else shows ↑ or ↓

entries.title: The main circle's ring keeps filling while you're walking or driving (it could freeze empty until you left the app)
tryIt: Walk with the app open on the Salah page as a prayer begins: the ring starts filling on time
Keep it open while moving: the ring and its colour keep up

entries.title: Streaks count a day whose last prayer was marked late (from the watch, the widget or a notification around Fajr, or an edited time) instead of resetting to 0
tryIt: Mark yesterday's last prayer after Fajr (widget / notification / watch): tap the city in the top bar → the streak includes yesterday
Next day: the streak carries on instead of starting from 0

entries.title: Mosques: "Search this area" sits right under the top pill again (not over the pins), and the sheet shrunk to its bar no longer scrolls its list
tryIt: Map → Mosques → pan away: "Search this area" appears just under the top pill
Swipe the mosque sheet down to its bar and try to scroll it: it doesn't move; pull it back up and the list starts at the top

entries.title: Sort button moved top right (where Edit was): shows the field + ↑ / ↓ and fills green while a sort is on; no bulk Edit / Delete for azkar
tryIt: Zikr tab → History & Azkar → Azkar: top right is ↑↓ (Name, A to Z)
Tap it → Pace: the button turns green with the pace icon and ↑
No Edit on Azkar any more; delete a zikr from its own page (History keeps Edit)

entries.title: Sort button's active look is softer: green icon and arrow on a light green tint (was a solid green fill)
tryIt: Zikr tab → History & Azkar → Azkar → sort by Pace: the top-right button shows the pace icon + ↑ in green on a pale green capsule
Try it in dark mode too

entries.title: Completion moment smooth again: the circle keeps the prayer you marked until the sweep ends (no flash of the next prayer or the day's score), and the list waits too
tryIt: Hold the circle to mark the current prayer: its arc sweeps closed, then the next prayer fades in
Open the list and mark the last prayer of the day: the circle stays still through the moment, then 'today's score' comes in and all five rows unfold

entries.title: New first-run setup: one calm question per screen with a ring for progress, every step skippable and filled in with your settings; the review nudges towards the best permissions; Bismillah hands off into the everyday opening
tryIt: Open the app after updating: walk through, or tap Skip
On the review, tap a row to change it; bismillah takes you in
Beta builds: Settings → Run setup again

entries.title: Automatic calculation method (the new default): it follows the country you're in, so travelling changes it for you; Settings shows what it resolved to
tryIt: Setup → Your calculation method → Automatic says which method it uses here
Settings → Method → Automatic (ISNA)

entries.title: Madhab explained: only Asr changes, with both Asr times side by side and a little shadow sketch
tryIt: Setup → When does Asr begin? → tap Shafi'i / Hanafi and watch Asr change

entries.title: With Always location, prayer times, reminders, widgets, the Fajr alarm and the watch follow you when you travel (even when shukr isn't open)
tryIt: Allow Always, then travel: the city and times update by themselves

entries.title: Fajr alarm reads "Start" / "End" of Fajr (was Fajr / Sunrise) in the setup, Settings and the Shortcut; an untouched rule now really means before the start
tryIt: Setup → Wake up for Fajr → turn it on: "10 min before Start of Fajr · tomorrow 5:25 AM"
Settings → Alarm Settings → the wheels say Start / End

entries.title: The watch counter is now the phone's (beads, hundreds dots, the fine ring, edge to edge), marking plays the phone's completion moment, tap to mark / "Unmark X?", the pause screen has no empty bubbles, and Tasbih Fatimah shows the phrase above the count
tryIt: Watch → Zikr → Freestyle, count past 100
Watch → hold the prayer ring
Watch → Zikr → Tasbih Fatimah: the phrase sits above the count

entries.title: Setup reminders use the same bell as Settings: one per prayer, tap to cycle off → start → nudge (a nudge = halfway through and with 30 min left, if it isn't marked); Settings' info now says the same
tryIt: Setup → Reminders that help → tap a bell: off → start → nudge
Settings → Notifications → ⓘ: the nudge line matches

entries.title: Setup's Fajr alarm shows just the result under the wheels: "Alarm tomorrow 5:25 AM · Fajr starts 5:35 AM"
tryIt: Setup → Wake up for Fajr → turn it on and turn the wheels

entries.title: Rate tile: the ⇆ flip mark, and "1.1s faster" / "0.4s slower" than your usual under it (per tasbeeh when flipped)
tryIt: Count a zikr you've counted before → pause: the rate tile says faster / slower / about your usual
Tap the rate tile: per tasbeeh, the comparison flips with it
Finish: the results screen compares with your usual before this session

entries.title: New installs start with Fajr off (the Fajr alarm covers it), Dhuhr / Asr / Maghrib with nudges and Isha at the start; if you've used shukr before, your reminders stay exactly as they were
tryIt: Setup → Reminders that help: the bells show what you have now
A fresh install: off · nudge · nudge · nudge · start

entries.title: After you finish a task, the Zikr page lands on the next task to do, not the finished one at the bottom
tryIt: Zikr → finish a task's goal → Done: the next task in your order is in the middle
Finish the last one: it wraps to the first task still to do, or freestyle when all are done
